blocks.text: Verdict. No new fund data this quarter: the latest GP figures remain those of 30 June 2026 - portfolio value US$1,352M (36% of scaled target), 36.0% called, investment-level gross performance of >50% IRR / 1.60x MoM, fund-level returns not meaningful. On the market side jet fuel has eased to about 4% above IATA’s assumption and US and European fares are up, but global traffic fell 0.5% yoy in September and North America has turned negative. Assessment: “on track as last reported, awaiting confirmation”.

IATA September traffic: RPKs down 0.5% yoy; Middle East down 8.0%, North America down 1.6% [IATA, 30 October 2026].

items: Fuel relief helps the weakest credits: Tier 3 lessees are 39.5% of exposure, and spot fuel is now close to the level IATA assumed.
Regional mix is a mild headwind: 54.4% of exposure is in slow-growing APAC and 31.2% in the Americas, where North American traffic fell 1.6%; Middle East exposure is limited to Flynas (7.5%).
Exit market still open: AerCap’s 45% sale margin is consistent with the GP’s reported multiples of 1.40x to 2.11x on closed monetisations.
